title: Hackathon Kickoff & Team Formation
description: 24-hour hackathon open to all students. Prizes up to $2,000. Form teams of 2–4 and register by July 31.

title: Guest Lecture: AI in Healthcare
description: Dr. Priya Nair from Stanford Medicine discusses how large language models are reshaping clinical diagnostics.

title: Intramural Basketball Finals
description: Cheer on your classmates in the semester-end intramural basketball championship. Free entry for all students.

title: Winter Concert — Student Orchestra
description: Annual winter showcase featuring the University Orchestra and Jazz Ensemble. Tickets free with student ID.

title: Study Abroad Information Session
description: Learn about semester and year-long programs in Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Financial aid is available.

title: Mental Health & Wellness Fair
description: Free counseling consultations, mindfulness workshops, and stress-relief activities ahead of finals. Open 10 AM–4 PM.

title: Professor Q&A: Research Opportunities for Undergrads
description: Meet faculty members looking for undergraduate research assistants for the fall semester. Bring your CV.

title: Club Fair — Find Your Community
description: Over 120 student clubs and organizations will be tabling. Great opportunity for new students to get involved.
